I’ve encountered some problems with the ephemeral root ID reuse in our custom setup, so I need to address that. To fix it, I’ll run the custom tests and focus on ensuring the doctests normalize properly to account for original whitespace. I also see the need to improve documentation by splitting the comment about "separator never" since there are already max split separators present, and it's unnecessary to reiterate that.
